title: Rescued sailor boards Kuroda
description:
A relieved Michael Harris walks to sick bay immediately after boarding the
USAV Kuroda. Harris spent nearly 8 hours at sea stranded in a storm with
waves 15-20 feet high battering his sailboat. His radio batteries were
running low, and he expended his last flare before being found by the
Kuroda. Harris is being escorted to sick bay by Spc Dustin Baldwin the
vessel medic, and Spc Solis Tran.  Video by Spc . Courtney Hull, 805th TC
Co.
